title: Migrant women tell of sexual harassment in Spain's crisis-hit Ceuta
summary: Some women who entered Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta on July 30 as part of a mass migrant crossing say the hardships of ​sleeping rough as they wait to be registered are compounded by the threat and fear of sexual harassment.
